== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013). The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>707ea5d7fa76928e97a88ec237db7e221e2db9ef</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
